briefdescription.para: Filters a line containing symbolizer markup and writes the human-readable results to the output stream.

detaileddescription.para: Invalid or unimplemented markup elements are removed. Some output may be deferred until future filter() or finish() call.

briefdescription.para: Records that the input stream has ended and writes any deferred output.
Filter to convert parsed log symbolizer markup elements into human-readable text.
